title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR): Arquitetura Experimental de Endereçamento Densitário, Persistência Transacional e Avaliação Reprodutível
description: Preprint and reproducible software research release describing BDR v0.1.0, an experimental persistent key-value database architecture investigating deterministic resolutive addressing, local partitioning, adaptive structures, segmented write-ahead logging, atomic checkpoints, crash recovery, and durability-parity benchmarking against SQLite. This release is a Research Preview and does not claim production readiness or strict worst-case O(1) complexity for the complete engine.
